finding: The audit two-group DESeq2 fit for High Run vs High Control (results/audit_two_group/run_run_vs_sed_frail-high) gives all 8 paper-named HR-vs-HC DEGs at padj < 0.1 (Ifi47 0.011, Iigp1 0.002, Isg20 0.011, Mpeg1 0.003, Ccl8 3e-6, Ctss 3e-6, Fosb 0.032, Junb 0.074), in the paper's direction. The joint 4-group model recorded as paper_aligned gives only Ctss and Mpeg1 at padj < 0.1.
interpretation: The paper's pairwise DEG lists (S3.5.p3, FIG6e) were most likely produced by separate two-group DESeq2 fits ('for each pairwise comparison', S2.10.p2), not by contrasts from the two-factor model. The two-group audit (54 DEGs HR vs HC, 6 DEGs LR vs LC) is therefore probably closer to the paper's DEG lists than the joint-model counts (15 and 10).
unchanged: GSEA direction (OXPHOS up in LR vs LC, down in HR vs HC, negative interaction) is reproduced from the joint-model rankings.
